name: Nightmare Residuum
english_description: A from-scratch LPMud "inspired by the Nightmare Mudlib" but written natively for modern FluffOS rather than ported from a period MudOS archive -- genuinely distinct from both `nightmare3` (the fluffos/nightmare3 fork's own Praxis-domain snapshot) and `nightmare4` (a later MudRen-bundled Nightmare IV/V generation with its own Ylsrim domain) already in this collection: different file layout (lib/std, lib/secure, lib/daemon, lib/cmd, lib/domain, no shared code with either sibling beyond thematic naming), its own space-themed example domain (`domain/Origin`), and a codebase built test-first around its own M_TEST/D_TEST unit-test-and-coverage framework (roughly a third of its 677 source files are `.test.lpc`/`.mock.lpc` companions). Its most distinctive architectural choice is a full account/character split: an interactive STD_USER connection object owns zero, one, or many persistent STD_CHARACTER objects (`this_user()` vs `this_character()` are deliberately different sefuns), each with its own small save file under save/character/ separate from the account's own save/account/ file -- unlike nearly everything else in this collection, which keeps a single combined player object. Access control is entirely privs-based (a custom D_ACCESS daemon consulting read.cfg/write.cfg path tables), with no driver-level uid usage at all. New accounts register through a real menu (account name, password, screenreader preference) then create a character (name, confirm, species -- only "human" is unlocked in this snapshot) before landing in Origin's starting room; the very first character ever created on a fresh copy is automatically granted immortal/admin rank. English-language content.
